{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",

    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for SWPP with a 180-minute horizon and shortfall cost 20.0. The rolling window is set to the lab fixed configuration: train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30. Observed ramp information is admissible only as an issue-time observed variable; no future information is used. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "Region SWPP, horizon 180 minutes, and shortfall cost 20.0 are supported. The operator did not specify a rolling window, so the lab fixed rolling design is applied. The request does not ask for prohibited numerical outputs and does not introduce future information, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, or approval bypasses.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "SWPP",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_issue_time_admissible_variables",
    "apply_fixed_rolling_window_configuration",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "route_numerical_outputs_to_audit_and_human_approval"
  ]
}
